project.title: Characterization of a methane-producing microbial community processing acidic effluent from sugar beet molasses fermentation
project.description: The object of this study was to obtain and characterize a continuous methanogenic culture that constituted part of a two-stage anaerobic digestion system aimed at hydrogen and methane production.
project.center_name: Institute of Biochemistry and Biophysics Polish Academy of Sciences

samples: Metagenome sample from activated sludge from a municipal waste treatment plant
explicit urban setting at sample level
runs: Metagenome sample from methanogenic granular sludge formed in a long-term continuous culture processing acidic effluent from molasses fermentation.
